adjudication.rationale: `refreshOAuthTokens` returns a native `fetch` `Response` object when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId` is truthy (packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts). But Zoho integrations call it with an `axios` refresh function and then treat the return value as an axios response, e.g. zoho-bigin `const tokenInfo = await refreshOAuthTokens(...); if (!tokenInfo.data.error) { ... }` (packages/app-store/zoho-bigin/lib/CalendarService.ts) and zohocrm similarly reads `zohoCrmTokenInfo.data.error` (packages/app-store/zohocrm/lib/CalendarService.ts). In sync mode, `tokenInfo.data`/`zohoCrmTokenInfo.data` will be `undefined` on a `Response`, causing incorrect behavior (likely a runtime exception when accessing `.error`) and breaking token refresh handling.
